extDescription.message: SpoofCheck shows who an email claims to be from, verifies those claims via SPF, DKIM, DMARC, reverse DNS, and Received headers, and gives a clear spoofing verdict.

arIgnored.message: $1 other Authentication-Results header(s) from the same organization ignored

dmarcOwnNeutral.message: SPF not aligned; DKIM not verified locally · p=$1

dmarcOwnFail.message: No aligned SPF pass and no aligned DKIM signature · p=$1

orgNote.message: Relaxed alignment approximates the organizational domain by its last two labels.

reasonSpfFail.message: SPF fails and no aligned DKIM pass for $1.

reasonMixed.message: No aligned authentication pass for $1; treat with caution.

footnote.message: ⚠ Only the handoff IP is recorded by your own server; earlier hops can be forged.

arWarnDetail.message: Not from your receiving server ($1) or its organization, so it may be forged. It was ignored. Header content:

reasonDockedAR.message: Checks pass for $1, but an untrusted Authentication-Results header is present (possibly forged).

reasonMixedAR.message: No aligned authentication pass for $1, and an untrusted Authentication-Results header is present.

reasonSpfFailDkimUnverified.message: SPF fails, but an aligned DKIM signature for $1 is present and could not be verified locally.

reasonInternal.message: Delivered inside your Microsoft 365 tenant; never crossed the internet, so SPF/DKIM/DMARC don't apply.

naInternalNote.message: Delivered inside Microsoft 365; there is no internet hop to check.

internalHopNote.message: Microsoft 365 internal hop (not an internet handoff)

internalStampWarnAr.message: Internal stamp present, but an Authentication-Results header came from a non-Microsoft server ($1)

internalStampWarnDetail.message: The X-MS-Exchange-...-AuthAs: Internal header can be forged by outsiders, so it was ignored and the message was checked normally.

reasonDockedInternalStamp.message: Checks pass for $1, but an "internal message" stamp was present on a message that was not delivered internally (possibly forged).

reasonMixedInternalStamp.message: No aligned authentication pass for $1, and an "internal message" stamp was present on a message that was not delivered internally.
